title: Write 404.html with the right headers natively
description: The renderer writes 404.html with the projection's default headers, so bin/fix_404_headers.py has to rewrite it (text/html, no Cache-Control) after every full render, because CloudFront serves it through the error-response path. Write it correctly in the first place and retire the script. Done: check-404 passes right after a render with no follow-up step.
right_now_summary: The renderer still writes 404.html with wrong headers, so a cleanup script is needed after each full render.
